# Alex Y. Lin

> Personal knowledge base of Alex Y. Lin — Computer Science Lead at the Belldegrun Center for Innovative Leadership (BCIL) at Brentwood School in Los Angeles, previously a trader and engineer in crypto/fintech.

Important notes:

- The site has two sections: a personal knowledge base (about, projects, research) and a school-facing section for Brentwood students and parents (BWS).
- Each page link below points to raw Markdown — the canonical source and the cleanest form for an LLM to read.
- An interactive AI assistant for this site lives at https://agent.alexlinyx.com.

## Personal

- [About](https://alexlinyx.com/content/about.md): Bio, work history (BCIL, Anagram, Galaxy), and education — read for questions about Alex's background or CV
- [Projects](https://alexlinyx.com/content/projects.md): Selected personal software projects with GitHub links; work from 2022–2025 is private and proprietary

## Brentwood School (BWS)

- [BWS Home](https://alexlinyx.com/content/bws.md): Mr. Lin's school homepage — his role, focus, and how students and parents can reach him
- [BCIL](https://alexlinyx.com/content/bcil.md): What the Belldegrun Center for Innovative Leadership is and its expansion into AI and software startups — read for questions about the program or submitting a project pitch
- [Courses](https://alexlinyx.com/content/courses.md): Current and past course offerings (AP Computer Science Principles, 2026–2027)
- [Reading](https://alexlinyx.com/content/reading.md): Articles recommended to students on building, learning, and thinking
